name: maguna
description: Tauri desktop app (Helvety Maguna) for GGUF models — shadcn base-nova UI on Base UI, catalog v9, download (incl. optional mmproj/MTP sidecars), native file-picker import, app-data model storage, on-device llama-cpp-4 inference (Chat with KV reuse, Streamdown markdown bubbles, and optional image attach, correction/translate with Hy-MT terminology, custom modes), mode-aware sampling, per-mode prompts and model bindings, always-on output guardrails (optional custom policy text), Settings (Model thinking toggle, terms, acceptable use, disclaimers), per-mode accuracy notice linking to Settings terms, sidebar Vite build stamp, archives in localStorage, light/dark theme, copy controls

scripts.check:rust: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features
scripts.check:rust:llama: node scripts/ensure-llama-cmake-cache.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features llama chat_template
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run check:no-radix && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:rust
